quest.title: The Mystery of Tecoloapan Beach
quest.description: As you get closer to the island in the fog, a strange noise can be heard from it — what secret past lies hidden in its depths?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Unveil the secrets of the island within the fog

dialogues.speaker: Sakaw
dialogues.text: The fog on the sea has thickened lately. A worrying sign...

dialogues.speaker: Sakaw
dialogues.text: Err... Ah, that depends on what legend you wish to hear, outlander hero...

dialogues.speaker: Sakaw
dialogues.text: Two reasons have been given for that floating island and the huge graffiti: One more akin to a story, and the other to a real legend.

dialogues.speaker: Sakaw
dialogues.text: Which would you like to hear, outlander warrior?

response.speaker: Sakaw
response.text: Hmm, there's always a romantic spin with stories... There, the origin of the graffiti on the foggy floating island is part of The Tale of Qoyllor and Ukuku.

response.speaker: Sakaw
response.text: It is said that the girl named Qoyllor left a huge work of graffiti by the beach in order to contact her Father Sun.

response.speaker: Sakaw
response.text: Her Father Sun saw the graffiti from the sky and thus whisked her away from the earth... That's sort of how the story goes.

response.speaker: Sakaw
response.text: It is said that the unsettling mist was bestowed by the Sun Father upon the people of the surface, as punishment for stealing his daughter's power.

response.speaker: Sakaw
response.text: *sigh* Be it legend or story, the rising fog is never a good sign.

response.speaker: Sakaw
response.text: Outlander hero... That place is probably fraught with danger, so you must take care not to get too close...

response.speaker: Sakaw
response.text: As for the real legend... It is said that a long time ago, there was an evil sorcerer who disguised himself as a Wayob and bewitched the heroes of the tribe.

response.speaker: Sakaw
response.text: Later, the tribal heroes had to seal the pitch-black wicked wizard within that giant graffiti...

response.speaker: Sakaw
response.text: As to why the ocean surface has become like this... They say that it presages the moment when the evil wizard shall shatter the seal and escape its grasp.

talks.objective: Head to the center that is sealed by the graffiti

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Wayob Manifestation
dialogues.text: Ah, at last... Were it not for your aid, outlander hero, we might have long been overwhelmed by our pitch-black foe...

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Wayob Manifestation
dialogues.text: ...Long ago, the tribespeople here were ensorcelled, enchanted by our enemy, and many Nightsouls became entangled by the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Wayob Manifestation
dialogues.text: At the seal's location, even the power of Night's manifestation is slowly being chipped away... This seal severs all links with the outside world, yes, but with the source of the tribe's faith also.

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Wayob Manifestation
dialogues.text: It must be undone for there to be any fighting chance...

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Wayob Manifestation
dialogues.text: Thank you, outlander hero... The Nightsouls can find their way back to their dream-home, avoiding the blight that grips the Lord of the Night's realm.

dialogues.speaker: Weakened Wayob Manifestation
dialogues.text: Ah, at last, to be able to return to the quietude of Night...
